tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: The sites (embeds) in this account, with how many notes are open on each and what agents may see there.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: Notes reviewers left on the live sites, newest first. Default: open notes (new and in progress) on every site. Each has an id for get_note and update_note, and a short ref like "N-12".

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: One note in full: the page, the section heading, the CSS selector, the text before and after, the reviewer's words and its history.

tools.name: get_note_photo
tools.description: The photo a reviewer attached (the replacement image, or one that shows the problem), as an image. With which: "screenshot", the screenshot of the page as the reviewer saw it, any element they picked ringed in gold (get_note says whether a note has one).

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Set a note's status and/or reply. The reviewer sees both in the widget on their site. Use "doing" while working, "done" once the change is committed or deployed, "wontdo" with a reason when it will not be applied. Write the reply in the reviewer's language.

tools.name: export_notes
tools.description: Every open note, grouped by page, as one Markdown document (a checklist to work through).
